text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Biko Pegasus, we found ourselves back at that obstacle course facility again. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Our "Hero Base"
was once completely destroyed and wrecked by the rain.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But because everyone refused to give up,
we were able to make it this far—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —The Hero Base is finally finished!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The hero base that we had worked on little by little with Biko Pegasus and the others... was finally complete!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Turbo-senpai, let's check if there's anything unusual in town!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Monitor, activate! ...Alright, looks good! The town is safe and sound today too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! I drew a picture of the city!
Here's the base, and over here is the park!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Urara-senpai!
Hmm, looking at it like this, maybe I should rethink our patrol route...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I brought some soup I made at the dorm♪
There's enough for everyone waiting in the recovery room!
choice_data_list: Let's call the others and take a break.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Gotta get a solid recharge
and prepare for battle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, everyone's too preoccupied with the base.
Time to prep some pranks—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see right through your schemes!
Justice Biko, on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa~! Run awayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biko Pegasus and the others had a fun time
at the hero base—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone, get home safe, okay?!
choice_data_list: Shall we head home too?
Shall we head home too?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, there's somewhere I wanna drop by before heading back!
Mind keeping me company for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nostalgia! Right here, right here!
This is where we used to build our hero base back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We'd spread out a plastic sheet, bring our toys
and stuff with friends, and play superheroes, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A secret base just for the two of us.
...It was that excitement back then
that gave birth to the base we have now.
choice_data_list: Good thing the base is finally complete.
I'm glad the base is finally complete!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I really think so too.
A lot has happened, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We were all working so hard to build it,
and then this storm-like thing suddenly hit us...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The base was in shambles... it was a total, desperate pinch, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: But you were the one who inspired everyone.
Still, you inspired everyone.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...You know, the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, for just a moment...
I thought, 'Maybe this is the end for me.'"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Seeing everyone look so downcast, though, gave me the courage to stand up myself."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone stood up and said they'd help...
And then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...!! 
...I'm so glad... you didn't give up—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha!
Remembering it just makes me... heheh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
A hero shouldn't be acting like this.
choice_data_list: Even heroes can cry when they're happy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
...Ngh... Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, I'm okay now.
Though, it kinda... t-tingles!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So these tears are our little secret, okay?
Promise... alright!
choice_data_list: I can't ever break a promise with a hero.
I can't ever break a promise with a hero, okay?
Honestly, I was about to cry too
Honestly, I was about to cry too
Heroes always have their secrets, don't they?
Heroes always have their secrets, don't they? After all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So these tears are our little secret, okay?
Promise... alright!
choice_data_list: I can't ever break a promise with a hero.
I can't ever break a promise with a hero, okay?
Honestly, I was about to cry too
Honestly, I was about to cry too
Heroes always have their secrets, don't they?
Heroes always have their secrets, don't they? After all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and one more thing!
Whenever you feel like crying, Trainer,
you gotta cry in front of me!
choice_data_list: I'll try my best to do that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No way, you have to! Otherwise, I'll be
the only one embarrassed! That's a promise too, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus smiled happily.
And under the watchful gaze of the setting sun,
she exchanged a firm handshake with her.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, at times like this,
you're allowed to cry in front of a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "And if Trainer starts crying, that'll be a secret just between the two of us, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus looks proud of herself.
And under the watchful gaze of the setting sun,
the two of them laughed together.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right! A hero has secrets!
Because the weight on their shoulders is just that immense!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll be fine! Heroes are strong!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Because I'm not alone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to live up to her trust.
I secretly made that vow toward the setting sun.
